messages:
lina.p: starting a co-marketing push with CloudMart for their marketplace listing + a joint webinar. need rapid execution checklist. who can lead landing page + registration? :slightly_smiling_face:
chris.gtm: i'll own the landing page and registration funnel. prefer Wed or Thu mornings PT. recommend 40 min: 10 demo / 10 customer story / 15 q&a / 5 CTAs.
devin.prod: i'll own demo + product messaging. ask eng for the benchmark numbers (latency / cost per 1k tokens) we can publish. must be conservative and sourced.
lina.p: good. pairing notes: CloudMart wants a co-branded hero + 1-line quote. partner deliverable deadline: 2026-04-15 EOD. chris, can you set CTA variants?
chris.gtm: yes 0/50 AB test: "Start free trial" vs "Request a private demo". Split by cookie. Also routing: send all registrants to SFDC lead queue "CloudPartner_Webinar_Apr" and tag source=cloudmart_marketplace.
olivia.opsbot: automation: Created Marketo list "MKTO_CloudMart_Apr2026" and mapping to SFDC queue. Job 8019 scheduled daily.
devin.prod: benchmark ask to eng-runtime sent. if numbers aren't available, we'll use anonymized percent deltas vs baseline. don't claim absolute numbers without eng sign-off.
lina.p: messaging drafts: technical headline and business headline. i'll post two variants by EOD. include callouts for "Dedicated" and "Private" options.
partner.reps: CloudMart: we can provide logo SVG, a short customer quote, and a 30s clip. will send by 2026-04-14.
chris.gtm: quick note on form fields: company, role, size (optional), phone (optional). map role->tagging: eng/platform => tag: "technical_lead".
olivia.opsbot: reminder: Legal signed co-marketing terms 2026-04-01. Allowed assets: quote (<=50 words), logo, 30-60s video.
devin.prod: rehearsal planned Mon 10am PT. please have final slide deck by Fri. will demo switching between Hosted/Dedicated/Private in under 90s.
lina.p: blog plan: publish post that includes benchmark summary + webinar link. owner: lina. chris will provide social clips (30-60s) post-recording.
chris.gtm: follow-ups: 1) 24h email with recording + CTA; 2) 7-day nurture with tech one-pager + benchmark PDF. SDRs will use one-pager in outreach.
olivia.opsbot: ops snippet for sales ops: source=="cloudmart_marketplace" OR utm_campaign=="cloudmart_partner_apr" => list MKTO_CloudMart_Apr2026, assign queue CloudPartner_Webinar_Apr.
partner.reps: noted on supply dates. will confirm final quote Thursday morning.
lina.p: final checklist for launch readiness: partner assets in, eng numbers, landing page live, rehearsal complete. i'll do a readiness call Friday. thanks all. :rocket:
